curated_items.title: How BNY CEO Robin Vince Turns AI Optimism Into Action
curated_items.summary: “We choose to be AI optimists at BNY.” For Robin Vince, optimism means action. And that action starts before Monday morning: 📝 Use the weekend to build context 🤖 Review the latest AI agents and use cases 🏋️ Start Monday with an early workout 📰 Catch up on what’s happening in the world ✨ Let AI help prioritize the day The part AI won’t replace? “Human magic is not something we think is going to be disrupted.”
